items.title: Green and Ripe Acorns
items.alt: A fresh green acorn and a ripe chestnut brown acorn hang side by side from a shared twig beneath textured cups.
items.description: A fresh green acorn and a ripe chestnut brown acorn hang side by side from a shared twig beneath textured cups. An original acorn illustration for personal projects, nature activities and seasonal classroom materials.
